orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To create a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon, we will focus on investment-grade securities with a minimum credit rating of BBB+. The laddered maturity structure will ensure that no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year, providing a steady stream of cash flows and minimizing risk. We propose allocating 25% to a 1-year bond, 20% to a 2-year bond, 20% to a 3-year bond, 15% to a 4-year bond, and 20% to a 5-year bond. This structure allows for regular reinvestment of maturing bonds, maintaining a consistent portfolio duration and mitigating interest rate risk. The portfolio will be comprised of developed market securities, avoiding emerging market sovereign or corporate debt.
